rule: Polls only from pollsters in AAPOR's Transparency Initiative (John, 2026-09-29): the latest from up to five of them, and our own average of the ten most recent, the arithmetic shown. Each poll's figures are checked against the pollster's own release; a list of polls (Wikipedia's, labelled as secondary) is used only to find them and to count the polls left out.
